analysis.reasonEn: Up +8.0% over 48 days since the last buy signal. Current price $729.55 is above SMA20 $683.31 and EMA50 $646.12. RSI at 62.1 consolidates in neutral zone, MACD histogram at 3.1675 shows slowing improvement. Volume ratio at 0.10 (below 5-day average) indicates contraction. Overall market sentiment is at target allocation with leverage as the next step. Sentiment balance is 45 positive vs 55 negative, awaiting PCE/GDP. While the uptrend persists technically, momentum is waning and volume is contracting, limiting further upside potential. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
